q: Most Exalted is the Being in Whose control is all of the kingdom
and Who has power over everything.
v.s: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -
v.c: Blessed is the One in Whose Hands rests all authority. And He is Most Capable of everything.

q: He has created death and life to test which of you carry out the best acts
v.s: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -
v.c: ˹He is the One˺ Who created death and life in order to test which of you is best in deeds. And He is the Almighty, All-Forgiving.

q: He has created the seven heavens in layers. You will not see any inconsistency
in Allaah's creation. Look again. Do you see any cracks
v.s: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
v.c: ˹He is the One˺ Who created seven heavens, one above the other. You will never see any imperfection in the creation of the Most Compassionate. So look again: do you see any flaws?

q: and your gaze will return embarrassed
v.s: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.
v.c: Then look again and again— your sight will return frustrated and weary.

q: Indeed we have adorned the nearest
a means of pelting the Shayaateen
(see verses 6-10 of Surah 37). (In addition to this,)
v.s: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars] and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
v.c: And indeed, We adorned the lowest heaven with ˹stars like˺ lamps, and made them ˹as missiles˺ for stoning ˹eavesdropping˺ devils, for whom We have also prepared the torment of the Blaze.

q: The punishment of Jahannam shall be for those who disbelieve in their Rabb and it is indeed an evil place to return to
v.s: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.
v.c: Those who disbelieve in their Lord will suffer the punishment of Hell. What an evil destination!

q: When they are thrown into it, they will hear it roar as it rages
(in addition to it being a raging inferno, Jahannam will also be angry with the Kuffaar).
v.s: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.
v.c: When they are tossed into it, they will hear its roaring as it boils over,

q: (It will be raging so greatly that)
It will seem as if it is about to burst out of fury. Each time a group
is thrown into it, its keeper will ask,
v.s: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"
v.c: almost bursting in fury. Every time a group is cast into it, its keepers will ask them, “Did a warner not come to you?”

q: They will reply, “Certainly. A warner surely came to us but we rejected
and said, 'Allaah had not revealed anything
You are merely in great error.“'
v.s: They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'God has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"
v.c: They will reply, “Yes, a warner did come to us, but we denied and said, ‘Allah has revealed nothing. You are extremely astray.’”

q: They will also say, “If we had listened
(made an effort to understand what the Ambiyaa told us),
we would not be among the inmates
v.s: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."
v.c: And they will lament, “If only we had listened and reasoned, we would not be among the residents of the Blaze!”

q: May the inmates of the Blaze be distanced
v.s: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.
v.c: And so they will confess their sins. So away with the residents of the Blaze!

q: (knowing that He certainly sees them, they)
shall have forgiveness and a great reward
v.s: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
v.c: Indeed, those in awe of their Lord without seeing Him will have forgiveness and a mighty reward.

q: Speak secretly or openly, verily He
(Besides everything you say and do, Allaah knows even what you believe and think.)
v.s: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
v.c: Whether you speak secretly or openly—He surely knows best what is ˹hidden˺ in the heart.
v.h: Question 1) Does Allah Not Know His Creation?

q: (everything about you and what you do),
v.s: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?
v.c: How could He not know His Own creation? For He ˹alone˺ is the Most Subtle, All-Aware.

q: It is He Who placed the earth at your service so walk on its roads
(use the natural pathways through its mountains and forests)
and eat from His sustenance. To Him shall you be raised
v.s: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.
v.c: He is the One Who smoothed out the earth for you, so move about in its regions and eat from His provisions. And to Him is the resurrection ˹of all˺.

q: Do you have no fear that
(if you continue committing kufr and sinning)
He in the heavens will cause the earth to swallow you up after which it would quake?
v.s: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?
v.c: Do you feel secure that the One Who is in heaven will not cause the earth to swallow you up as it quakes violently?
v.h: Question 2) Are You out of Allah’s Reach?

q: Or do you have no fear that He in the heavens would send a devastating windstorm against you? Soon
(if you are destined to suffer punishment in this world,)
you shall come to know how
(However, if you are not destined to suffer punishment in this world for your kufr and sins, you shall certainly receive it in the Aakhirah.)
v.s: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.
v.c: Or do you feel secure that the One Who is in heaven will not unleash upon you a storm of stones. Only then would you know how ˹serious˺ My warning was!

q: (when it arrived)? (The Kuffaar must learn lessons from the destruction of past nations and mend their ways.)
v.s: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
v.c: And certainly those before them denied ˹as well˺, then how severe was My response!

q: the birds above them spreading their wings out and folding them in
It is only Ar-Rahmaan Who keeps them suspended in the air. Verily He is Watchful over everything
v.s: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.
v.c: Have they not seen the birds above them, spreading and folding their wings? None holds them up except the Most Compassionate. Indeed, He is All-Seeing of everything.
v.h: Question 3) Do You Not See Allah’s Power?

q: Besides Ar-Rahmaan, who can be your army to assist you
(against calamities and problems)? (None besides Allaah can be of any assistance.)
(by thinking that their gods can assist them).
v.s: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.
v.c: Also, which ˹powerless˺ force will come to your help instead of the Most Compassionate? Indeed, the disbelievers are only ˹lost˺ in delusion.

q: Who can give you sustenance if He Who sustains you
(despite acknowledging that Only Allaah sustains them,)
adamantly continue their rebellion and enmity
v.s: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.
v.c: Or who is it that will provide for you if He withholds His provision? In fact, they persist in arrogance and aversion ˹to the truth˺.

q: Is the one who grovels in fear or stumbles in doubt and fear more rightly guided
than he who walks Upright on the straight path?

(In a similar manner, the Mu'min who walks the straight path of Islaam without swaying to either extreme is more likely to attain salvation in the Aakhirah than the Kaafir who has no direction in life.)
v.s: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?
v.c: Who is ˹rightly˺ guided: the one who crawls facedown or the one who walks upright on the Straight Path?
v.h: Question 4) Are Believers and Disbelievers Equal?

q: Say, “It is Allaah Who created you and gave you ears, eyes and hearts
(and every other faculty for which you cannot ever repay Him). (However,)
Little is the gratitude that you show.”
(Besides failing to express verbal gratitude, many people even fail to use the favours of Allaah in a manner that pleases Him.)
v.s: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful."
v.c: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “He is the One Who brought you into being and gave you hearing, sight, and intellect. ˹Yet˺ you hardly give any thanks.”

q: Say, “It is Allaah Who spread you out on earth and it is to Him that you shall be gathered
v.s: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."
v.c: ˹Also˺ say, “He is the One Who has dispersed you ˹all˺ over the earth, and to Him you will ˹all˺ be gathered.”

q: take place if you are truthful?”
v.s: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
v.c: ˹Still˺ they ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass, if what you say is true?”
v.h: Question 6) Do You Still Deny the Hour?

q: with Allaah. I am only a clear warner
(warning you about its arrival so that you prepare for it).'
v.s: Say, "The knowledge is only with God, and I am only a clear warner."
v.c: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “That knowledge is with Allah alone, and I am only sent with a clear warning.”

q: the faces of the Kuffaar will contort
and it will be said, “This is what you used to ask for.”
v.s: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."
v.c: Then when they see the torment drawing near, the faces of the disbelievers will become gloomy, and it will be said ˹to them˺, “This is what you claimed would never come.”

q: “Tell me. If Allaah destroys me and everyone with me
(for we are convinced that we will enter Jannah),
the Kuffaar from a painful punishment
(in the Aakhirah, which will certainly come to them)?”
v.s: Say, [O Muhammad], “Have you considered: whether God should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?”
v.c: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Consider this: whether Allah causes me and those with me to die or shows us mercy, who will save the disbelievers from a painful punishment?”
v.h: Question 7) Who Else Can Aid You?

q: Say, “He is Ar-Rahmaan. We believe in Him and trust in Him.
(He will rescue us from every difficulty.)
(when you see your punishment either in this world or in the Aakhirah)
v.s: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."
v.c: Say, “He is the Most Compassionate—in Him ˹alone˺ we believe, and in Him ˹alone˺ we trust. You will soon know who is clearly astray.”

q: (If the Kuffaar still adamantly refuse to accept Allaah as the Only Ilaah, then)
“Tell me. If your water sinks to the depths of the earth
can provide you With pure water?”
(When their gods cannot even provide them with water, how will they possibly save them from Allaah's punishment?)
v.s: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
v.c: Say, “Consider this: if your water were to sink ˹into the earth˺, then who ˹else˺ could bring you flowing water?”
